title: Flai Raises $27M Series A to Scale AI CRM for Car Dealerships

tickers.name: Toyota Motor Corporation American Depositary Shares (Each representing ten Ordinary Shares)

summary:
An investment group headed by Base10 Partners has increased Flai's total capital to $33 million to support the growth of its software platform. Flai provides an AI native customer relationship management system tailored for automotive retail, automating interactions for both sales floors and service drives. The most recent funding round included participation from Toyota Ventures, Friedkin, Y Combinator, and Findlay Automotive Group.

The startup's tools manage phone calls, emails, and texts, and the company has expanded its customer base to include more than 20% of the top 50 dealer groups. Flai claims its automation generates about $100K in additional monthly revenue per client. The company will use the new funds to hire across its engineering, product, and sales teams as it has grown more than 20x over the last year.

selectedTweets.text:
Today, I'm thrilled to announce Flai's $27M Series A, led by Base10, bringing our total funding to $33M

This round also brings in some of the biggest names in automotive. With Toyota Ventures, Friedkin, and Findlay Automotive Group on board, we're now backed by the people who build, distribute, service, and sell cars.

A year ago, we announced our seed round with one product: an AI that answers the phone for car dealerships. Today, Flai is the first AI-native CRM for automotive, built for both the sales floor and the service drive.

Over the last year, @useflai has grown more than 20x, and we now work with over 20% of the top 50 dealer groups.

Dealerships still run on software from another era. One of the industry's biggest vendors started before the car was even invented. Dealer teams are buried in disconnected tools, and their customers feel every gap.

Flai changes that. On average, Flai generates ~$100K in additional monthly revenue for each dealership we work with.

With this funding, we'll invest aggressively in product and engineering to build the system modern dealerships run on.

I'm incredibly proud of our team and deeply grateful to our dealer partners for their trust in what we're building.

The round was led by @Base10Partners, with participation from:

@firstround 
@Toyota_Ventures 
@friedkingroup 
@ycombinator 
Findlay Automotive Group

We're growing extremely fast and hiring across every team: engineering, product, marketing, sales, and customer success. If you want to help rebuild how cars are sold and serviced, check out our careers page or reach out to me directly!
